{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Filter to treatment arm only
treatment_only = data_dedup[data_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute the fraction of patients who responded
fraction_responded = treatment_only['responded'].mean()

# Print only the required value
fraction_responded"}
